mapper.sql: FROM group_link handle LEFT JOIN group_link_preview legacy_preview ON legacy_preview.tenant_id = handle.tenant_id AND legacy_preview.group_link_id = handle.id LEFT JOIN group_link_import_batch source_batch ON source_batch.tenant_id = handle.tenant_id AND source_batch.id = handle.import_batch_id LEFT JOIN wa_group current_group ON current_group.tenant_id = handle.tenant_id AND current_group.group_jid = LOWER(TRIM(legacy_preview.group_jid)) LEFT JOIN wa_group_profile current_profile ON current_profile.tenant_id = current_group.tenant_id AND current_profile.group_id = current_group.id LEFT JOIN wa_group_invite current_invite ON current_invite.tenant_id = current_profile.tenant_id AND current_invite.id = current_profile.current_invite_id LEFT JOIN wa_group_invite input_invite ON input_invite.tenant_id = handle.tenant_id AND input_invite.invite_code = TRIM(legacy_preview.invite_code)
mapper.select:
WITH page_ids AS ( SELECT handle.tenant_id, handle.id
WHERE ORDER BY handle.created_at DESC, handle.id DESC LIMIT #{query.offset}, #{query.pageSize} ), page_groups AS ( SELECT DISTINCT page.tenant_id, current_group.id AS group_id FROM page_ids page INNER JOIN group_link page_handle ON page_handle.tenant_id = page.tenant_id AND page_handle.id = page.id INNER JOIN group_link_preview page_preview ON page_preview.tenant_id = page_handle.tenant_id AND page_preview.group_link_id = page_handle.id INNER JOIN wa_group current_group ON current_group.tenant_id = page_preview.tenant_id AND current_group.group_jid = LOWER(TRIM(page_preview.group_jid)) ), admins AS ( SELECT participant.tenant_id, participant.group_id, GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT participant.phone ORDER BY participant.phone SEPARATOR ', ' ) AS admin FROM wa_group_participant participant INNER JOIN page_groups page_group ON participant.tenant_id = page_group.tenant_id AND participant.group_id = page_group.group_id INNER JOIN account controlled_account ON controlled_account.tenant_id = participant.tenant_id AND controlled_account.ws_phone = participant.phone AND controlled_account.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE participant.presence_status = 1 AND participant.role IN (2, 3) AND participant.phone IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(participant.phone) <> '' GROUP BY participant.tenant_id, participant.group_id ), operable AS ( SELECT binding.tenant_id, binding.group_id, COUNT(DISTINCT binding.account_id) AS available_admin_count FROM wa_account_group_binding binding INNER JOIN page_groups page_group ON page_group.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id AND page_group.group_id = binding.group_id INNER JOIN wa_group_participant participant ON participant.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id AND participant.group_id = binding.group_id AND participant.id = binding.participant_id INNER JOIN account execution_account ON execution_account.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id AND execution_account.id = binding.account_id AND execution_account.deleted_at IS NULL AND execution_account.protocol_account_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(execution_account.protocol_account_id) <> '' INNER JOIN account_state execution_state ON execution_state.tenant_id = execution_account.tenant_id AND execution_state.account_id = execution_account.id AND execution_state.login_state = 1 AND execution_state.account_state = 2 WHERE participant.presence_status = 1 AND participant.role IN (2, 3) GROUP BY binding.tenant_id, binding.group_id ), owner_ranked AS ( SELECT participant.tenant_id, participant.group_id, participant.phone, participant.phone_country_iso2, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY participant.tenant_id, participant.group_id ORDER BY COALESCE(participant.role_observed_at, 0) DESC, participant.id ASC ) AS row_no FROM wa_group_participant participant INNER JOIN page_groups page_group ON participant.tenant_id = page_group.tenant_id AND participant.group_id = page_group.group_id WHERE participant.role = 3 AND participant.phone IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(participant.phone) <> '' ) SELECT handle.id, handle.link_url AS url, COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(current_group.display_name), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(input_invite.display_name), ''), current_profile.subject, input_invite.preview_subject ) AS groupName, COALESCE(current_profile.subject, input_invite.preview_subject) AS waSubject, current_group.group_jid AS groupJid, source_batch.source_file_name AS sourceFileName, COALESCE(current_invite.health_status, input_invite.health_status) AS healthStatus, COALESCE(current_invite.banned, input_invite.banned) AS banned, current_profile.member_count AS memberSize, COALESCE( current_invite.checked_member_count, input_invite.checked_member_count ) AS currentCount, owner.phone AS ownerPhone, admins.admin, handle.sync_protocol_mask AS syncProtocolMask, handle.origin, handle.membership_state AS membershipState, COALESCE(current_group.remark, input_invite.remark) AS remark, COALESCE(current_group.avatar_url, input_invite.avatar_url) AS avatarUrl, COALESCE( current_profile.metadata_observed_at, input_invite.preview_observed_at ) AS lastPreviewAt, COALESCE(current_invite.last_checked_at, input_invite.last_checked_at) AS lastCheckAt, COALESCE(current_invite.last_error_code, input_invite.last_error_code) AS lastHealthError, handle.created_at AS createdAt, handle.is_historical AS isHistorical, handle.is_post_control AS isPostControl, COALESCE(current_group.folder_id, handle.folder_id) AS folderId, folder.name AS folderName, CASE WHEN COALESCE(current_invite.invite_code, input_invite.invite_code) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CONCAT( 'https://chat.whatsapp.com/', COALESCE(current_invite.invite_code, input_invite.invite_code) ) END AS inviteUrl, COALESCE(operable.available_admin_count, 0) AS availableAdminCount, owner.phone_country_iso2 AS creatorCountryIso2, country.name_zh AS creatorCountryName, country.flag AS creatorCountryFlag, country.continent_code AS creatorContinentCode, CASE WHEN current_profile.wa_created_at IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE FLOOR(current_profile.wa_created_at / 1000) END AS groupCreatedAt, metadata_task.status AS metadataSyncStatus, metadata_task.last_success_at AS metadataSyncedAt, metadata_task.last_error_message AS metadataSyncError FROM page_ids page INNER JOIN group_link handle ON handle.tenant_id = page.tenant_id AND handle.id = page.id LEFT JOIN group_link_preview legacy_preview ON legacy_preview.tenant_id = handle.tenant_id AND legacy_preview.group_link_id = handle.id LEFT JOIN group_link_import_batch source_batch ON source_batch.tenant_id = handle.tenant_id AND source_batch.id = handle.import_batch_id LEFT JOIN wa_group current_group ON current_group.tenant_id = handle.tenant_id AND current_group.group_jid = LOWER(TRIM(legacy_preview.group_jid)) LEFT JOIN wa_group_profile current_profile ON current_profile.tenant_id = current_group.tenant_id AND current_profile.group_id = current_group.id LEFT JOIN wa_group_invite current_invite ON current_invite.tenant_id = current_profile.tenant_id AND current_invite.id = current_profile.current_invite_id LEFT JOIN wa_group_invite input_invite ON input_invite.tenant_id = handle.tenant_id AND input_invite.invite_code = TRIM(legacy_preview.invite_code) LEFT JOIN admins ON admins.tenant_id = current_group.tenant_id AND admins.group_id = current_group.id LEFT JOIN operable ON operable.tenant_id = current_group.tenant_id AND operable.group_id = current_group.id LEFT JOIN owner_ranked owner ON owner.tenant_id = current_group.tenant_id AND owner.group_id = current_group.id AND owner.row_no = 1 LEFT JOIN country country ON country.iso2 = owner.phone_country_iso2 AND country.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN group_folder folder ON folder.tenant_id = handle.tenant_id AND folder.id = COALESCE(current_group.folder_id, handle.folder_id) AND folder.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN group_metadata_sync_task metadata_task ON metadata_task.tenant_id = handle.tenant_id AND metadata_task.group_link_id = handle.id ORDER BY handle.created_at DESC, handle.id DESC
